title: Brain-JEPA: Brain Dynamics Foundation Model with Gradient Positioning and Spatiotemporal Masking

layout.note: Three columns left to right: input data above the masking lattice; the observation and target encoders joined by an EMA arrow; a large pale frame with three aligned predictor rows. Dashed loss arrows run from the right frame back to the target representations at the bottom.

lesson: Draw a structured mask as a lattice: hatch the regions by type, fill the sampled targets solid, frame the visible block in a contrasting colour, then carry each region's colour through the encoders' outputs and the loss lines.
